title: Homemade unsweetened applesauce
summary: It is SO easy to make unsweetened applesauce at home and tastes better than store-bought. You can easily make it chunky or smooth depending on your preference.
ingredients: 2 pounds apples, cored and roughly chopped (with peel on or removed)
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a pot. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the apples are soft, about 15-20 minutes.
Wait until the apples are cooled then transfer to the blender. Give it quick pulses for chunky applesauce. Blend until completely smooth for apple puree.
